title: Authorization Is Checked, Not Assumed
limitations: Authorization is per document, not per (document, activity); the 14-activity matrix is not consulted at projection time.
The projection trusts its snapshot; it does not re-validate the provenance of the rows it is given.
D1 remains shim-validated only; no remote D1 or workerd run.
Two similarly named authorization types are exported from the package barrel.
No lifecycle-transition record type; state, reviewStatus, status and availability are immutable in place.
Support verification remains the lexical proxy, not entailment.
No real corpus or counsel determination.
